item.description:
Paste to save, smarter search, and a lot of polish.
- Press ⌘V anywhere outside a text field to save what's on the clipboard into the open folder: links, images, and links to images. Plain text too, if you turn it on in Settings → Bookmarks. - Links now keep their page's description. It shows in Quick Look, and search looks through it, with title matches listed first. - GIFs play in grid view while you hover over them or select them.

Folder groups, and a fresh coat of paint.
- **Groups** in the side panel: right-click a folder, or several, and choose *group folders*. Fold a group to tidy it away; the folder you have open stays in sight. Rename one with ⌘R or a right-click. - Drag folders and whole groups to reorder them, in and out of groups. The row lifts and the others make room. - 18 new folder colours, nine bright and nine subtle. The bar at the top takes on the open folder's colour. - Send feedback has moved to the top bar, next to the sidebar button. - Getting started folds down to the bottom of the side panel, and the panel scrolls as one. - Calmer search: quieter recent searches and actions, tighter lists. - Smoother scrolling, especially in big folders and the grid.

Ochre is now signed and notarized by Apple. Nothing changes in how you use it.
- Opening Ochre for the first time no longer needs a trip to System Settings: macOS just asks once whether to open an app downloaded from the internet. - Updates are checked by Apple before they reach you.
